name: usagebar
description: Two rows under the prompt: context left until auto-compact with tokens in/out/total and cost, and the 5-hour and weekly rate-limit windows with their resets. Optional usage caps: as usage nears a cap you set, the agent is told to wrap up and hand off.

cap5h.title: 5-hour cap (%)
cap5h.description: Wrap the agent up at this share of the 5-hour window. 0: no cap.

capWeek.title: Weekly cap (%)
capWeek.description: Wrap the agent up at this share of the weekly window. 0: no cap.

warnAt.title: Heads-up (points before the cap)
warnAt.description: How far below a cap the agent is first told to aim for a stopping point.

wrapAt.title: Wrap-up (points before the cap)
wrapAt.description: How far below a cap the agent is told to wrap up and write a handoff.

onCap.title: At the cap
onCap.description: wind-down: refuse tool calls so the agent writes its handoff and stops. warn-only: only tell it.
